THE DARKNESS IS AS A DEADLY
VENOMOUS SNAKE,

LOCKED ONTO ITS PREY,
WAITING FOR ITS CHANCE TO STRIKE.

AND THE TOP PREDATORS,
OFTEN CAMOUFLAGE AS
THE MOST INNOCENT BEINGS,

WHEN LEAST EXPECTED.

YOU COULD
THINK OF,

THIS DARK WORLD
AS IF ITS
BLOODSTREAM.

AS AN APPRENTICE
AT A PHARMACY
IN JUST ANOTHER TOWN IN THIS WORLD,

I HAVE TO KEEP CALM
AT ALL TIMES.

THWAP

TRACE OF FEAR

WILL GET YOU SWALLOWED
UP BY THE DARKNESS
OF THIS WORLD.

AFTER BEING IN THIS WORLD
FOR 2 YEARS.
